propositions: Three Copilot rebar skills (rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, rebar-debug) silently fail to register in GitHub Copilot CLI due to invalid SKILL.md frontmatter: two exceed the 1024-character description limit and one contains unquoted colons that break YAML parsing.
Copilot CLI enforces the Agent Skills spec but provides no error or warning when skills are dropped, making the failure invisible until runtime discovery.
SKILL.md frontmatter descriptions must be rewritten as YAML folded block scalars and trimmed to <= 1024 characters while preserving each skill's invocation trigger.

A new deterministic CI lint (scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py) must validate every tracked SKILL.md frontmatter for YAML parsability, description presence/length, and name format/length constraints, integrated into the make lint target.
